sloka: प्रकाशम् च अभिरामम् च ददृशुः देशम् उत्तमम् ।ततः तस्मिन् बिले भीमे नाना पादप संकुले ॥४-५०-२१॥
transliteration: prakāśam ca abhirāmam ca dadṛśuḥ deśam uttamam ।tataḥ tasmin bile bhīme nānā pādapa saṁkule ॥4-50-21॥

translations.english: Holding one another's hands, they went in for a distance of one yojana inside the cave that was densely covered with several kinds of trees.
